payload.model_patch:
diff --git a/xarray/core/concat.py b/xarray/core/concat.py
index ecae2566..fc65ee6b 100644
--- a/xarray/core/concat.py
+++ b/xarray/core/concat.py
@@ -330,6 +330,39 @@ def _dataset_concat(
         result_vars = {}
     result_vars.update(dim_coords)
 
+    # add variables that are present in some but not all datasets
+    # (these are variables that are not in variables_to_merge because they
+    # are missing from some datasets, but they should still be included in
+    # the result with NaN values for the missing entries)
+    all_vars = set()
+    for ds in datasets:
+        all_vars.update(ds.variables)
+    missing_vars = all_vars - set(result_vars) - concat_over - dim_names
+    if missing_vars:
+        for var in missing_vars:
+            # find which datasets have this variable
+            present_ds = [ds for ds in datasets if var in ds.variables]
+            if len(present_ds) == len(datasets):
+                continue  # shouldn't happen, but just in case
+            # get the variable from the first dataset that has it
+            v = present_ds[0].variables[var]
+            # create a list of variables, filling in missing ones with NaN
+            vars_list = []
+            for ds in datasets:
+                if var in ds.variables:
+                    vars_list.append(ds.variables[var])
+                else:
+                    # create a variable with the same dims but NaN values
+                    # broadcast to the common shape
+                    new_dims = v.dims
+                    new_shape = tuple(dims_sizes.get(d, 1) for d in new_dims)
+                    new_data = np.full(new_shape, fill_value, dtype=v.dtype)
+                    vars_list.append(Variable(new_dims, new_data))
+            # ensure common dims and concatenate
+            vars_list = list(ensure_common_dims(vars_list))
+            combined = concat_vars(vars_list, dim, positions)
+            result_vars[var] = combined
+
     # assign attrs and encoding from first dataset
     result_attrs = datasets[0].attrs
     result_encoding = datasets[0].encoding
